title: The Cult Doctor Who 'Cured' Paranoia—By Inducing It Temporarily
hook: He believed the only way to break distrust was to make you more paranoid first. Some never recovered.
why_this_can_go_viral: The irony of 'curing' paranoia by making someone paranoid is darkly shocking and highly shareable.

why_this_can_go_viral: The emotional weight of erasing family memories triggers both horror and morbid curiosity.
